digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) & RP-04 operation-scoped configuration design
propositions: An ADR documenting immutable non-secret operation configuration composed separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings must be drafted from approved research and recorded in project format
The ADR must cite every external dependency and OSS behavior claim to specific primary sources and durable research artifacts with exact references

The ADR must record approved decisions on operation snapshot precedence, composition ownership, provider-native auth injection, static carriers, subprocess environment rules, rotation strategy, and op-cert startup without claiming to supersede unaffected prior ADRs
The ADR must preserve all unaffected decisions in ADR 0049 (Ed25519/DSSE protocol, trust roots, producer, SSM persistence) while narrowing only the per-job retrieval and runtime composition seam

Generated artifacts (docs/adr/README.md, .numbers/0098) must pass mechanical checks (gen_adr_index, check_adr_numbers, conflict markers, linting) and a numbered Draft Critique must explicitly resolve or clear uncited claims and ADR conflicts before maintainer approval
